pli-tv-bu-vb-np5:1.1.1: tena samayena buddho bhagavā rājagahe viharati veḷuvane kalandakanivāpe.
pli-tv-bu-vb-np5:1.1.2: tena kho pana samayena uppalavaṇṇā bhikkhunī sāvatthiyaṃ viharati.
pli-tv-bu-vb-np5:1.1.3: athakho uppalavaṇṇā bhikkhunī pubbaṇhasamayaṃ nivāsetvā pattacīvaramādāya sāvatthiṃ piṇḍāya pāvisi
pli-tv-bu-vb-np5:1.1.4: sāvatthiyaṃ piṇḍāya caritvā pacchābhattaṃ piṇḍapātapaṭikkantā yena andhavanaṃ tenupasaṅkami divāvihārāya
pli-tv-bu-vb-np5:1.1.5: andhavanaṃ ajjhogāhetvā aññatarasmiṃ rukkhamūle divāvihāraṃ nisīdi.
pli-tv-bu-vb-np5:1.1.6: tena kho pana samayena corā katakammā gāviṃ vadhitvā maṃsaṃ gahetvā andhavanaṃ pavisiṃsu.
pli-tv-bu-vb-np5:1.1.7: addasā kho coragāmaṇiko uppalavaṇṇaṃ bhikkhuniṃ aññatarasmiṃ rukkhamūle divāvihāraṃ nisinnaṃ.
pli-tv-bu-vb-np5:1.1.9: sace me puttabhātikā passissanti viheṭhayissanti imaṃ bhikkhuninti
pli-tv-bu-vb-np5:1.1.11: athakho so coragāmaṇiko maṃse pakke varamaṃsāni gahetvā paṇṇena puṭaṃ bandhitvā uppalavaṇṇāya bhikkhuniyā avidūre rukkhe ālaggetvā
pli-tv-bu-vb-np5:1.1.12: yo passati samaṇo vā brāhmaṇo vā dinnaṃyeva haratūti vatvā pakkāmi.
pli-tv-bu-vb-np5:1.1.13: assosi kho uppalavaṇṇā bhikkhunī samādhimhā vuṭṭhahitvā tassa coragāmaṇikassa imaṃ vācaṃ bhāsamānassa.
pli-tv-bu-vb-np5:1.1.14: athakho uppalavaṇṇā bhikkhunī taṃ maṃsaṃ gahetvā upassayaṃ agamāsi.
pli-tv-bu-vb-np5:1.1.15: athakho uppalavaṇṇā bhikkhunī tassā rattiyā accayena taṃ maṃsaṃ sampādetvā uttarāsaṅgena bhaṇḍikaṃ bandhitvā vehāsaṃ abbhuggantvā veḷuvane paccuṭṭhāsi.
pli-tv-bu-vb-np5:1.2.1: tena kho pana samayena bhagavā gāmaṃ piṇḍāya paviṭṭho hoti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-np5:1.2.3: athakho uppalavaṇṇā bhikkhunī yenāyasmā udāyi tenupasaṅkami upasaṅkamitvā āyasmantaṃ udāyiṃ etadavoca
pli-tv-bu-vb-np5:1.2.8: sace me tvaṃ antaravāsakaṃ dadeyyāsi evamahampi santappito bhaveyyaṃ antaravāsakenāti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-np5:1.2.9: mayaṃ kho bhante mātugāmā nāma kicchalābhā idañca me antimaṃ pañcamaṃ cīvaraṃ
pli-tv-bu-vb-np5:1.2.11: seyyathāpi bhagini puriso hatthiṃ datvā kacche vissajjeyya
pli-tv-bu-vb-np5:1.2.12: evameva kho tvaṃ bhagini bhagavato maṃsaṃ datvā mayhaṃ antaravāsakaṃ vissajjehīti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-np5:1.2.13: athakho uppalavaṇṇā bhikkhunī āyasmatā udāyinā nippīḷiyamānā antaravāsakaṃ datvā upassayaṃ agamāsi.
pli-tv-bu-vb-np5:1.2.14: bhikkhuniyo uppalavaṇṇāya bhikkhuniyā pattacīvaraṃ paṭiggaṇhantiyo uppalavaṇṇaṃ bhikkhuniṃ etadavocuṃ
pli-tv-bu-vb-np5:1.2.18: kathaṃ hi nāma ayyo udāyi bhikkhuniyā hatthato cīvaraṃ paṭiggahessati kicchalābho mātugāmoti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-np5:1.2.19: athakho tā bhikkhuniyo bhikkhūnaṃ etamatthaṃ ārocesuṃ.
pli-tv-bu-vb-np5:1.2.20: ye te bhikkhū appicchā …pe… te ujjhāyanti khīyanti vipācenti
pli-tv-bu-vb-np5:1.2.21: kathaṃ hi nāma āyasmā udāyi bhikkhuniyā hatthato cīvaraṃ pariggahessatīti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-np5:1.2.22: athakho te bhikkhū bhagavato etamatthaṃ ārocesuṃ …pe…
pli-tv-bu-vb-np5:1.2.23: saccaṃ kira tvaṃ udāyi bhikkhuniyā hatthato cīvaraṃ paṭiggahesīti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-np5:1.2.27: aññātako moghapurisa aññātikāya na jānāti paṭirūpaṃ vā appaṭirūpaṃ vā santaṃ vā asantaṃ vā
pli-tv-bu-vb-np5:1.2.28: tattha nāma tvaṃ moghapurisa aññātikāya bhikkhuniyā hatthato cīvaraṃ paṭiggahessasi
pli-tv-bu-vb-np5:1.2.29: netaṃ moghapurisa appasannānaṃ vā pasādāya pasannānaṃ vā bhiyyobhāvāya …pe…
pli-tv-bu-vb-np5:1.2.30: evañca pana bhikkhave imaṃ sikkhāpadaṃ uddiseyyātha
pli-tv-bu-vb-np5:1.2.31.1: yo pana bhikkhu aññātikāya bhikkhuniyā hatthato cīvaraṃ paṭiggaṇheyya nissaggiyaṃ pācittiyanti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-np5:1.2.32: evañcidaṃ bhagavatā bhikkhūnaṃ sikkhāpadaṃ paññattaṃ hoti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-np5:2.1: tena kho pana samayena bhikkhū kukkuccāyantā bhikkhunīnaṃ pārivaṭṭakacīvaraṃ nappaṭiggaṇhanti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-np5:2.3: kathaṃ hi nāma ayyā amhākaṃ pārivaṭṭakacīvaraṃ nappaṭiggaṇhissantīti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-np5:2.4: assosuṃ kho bhikkhū tāsaṃ bhikkhunīnaṃ ujjhāyantīnaṃ khīyantīnaṃ vipācentīnaṃ.
pli-tv-bu-vb-np5:2.5: athakho te bhikkhū bhagavato etamatthaṃ ārocesuṃ.
pli-tv-bu-vb-np5:2.6: athakho bhagavā etasmiṃ nidāne etasmiṃ pakaraṇe dhammiṃ kathaṃ katvā bhikkhū āmantesi
pli-tv-bu-vb-np5:2.7: anujānāmi bhikkhave pañcannaṃ pārivaṭṭakaṃ paṭiggahetuṃ bhikkhussa bhikkhuniyā sikkhamānāya sāmaṇerassa sāmaṇeriyā
pli-tv-bu-vb-np5:2.8: anujānāmi bhikkhave imesaṃ pañcannaṃ pārivaṭṭakaṃ paṭiggahetuṃ
pli-tv-bu-vb-np5:2.9: evañca pana bhikkhave imaṃ sikkhāpadaṃ uddiseyyātha
pli-tv-bu-vb-np5:2.10.1: yo pana bhikkhu aññātikāya bhikkhuniyā hatthato cīvaraṃ paṭigagaṇheyya aññatra pārivaṭṭakā nissaggiyaṃ pācittiyanti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-np5:3.1.6: mātito vā pitito vā yāva sattamā pitāmahayugā asambaddhā.
pli-tv-bu-vb-np5:3.1.10: channaṃ cīvarānaṃ aññataraṃ cīvaraṃ vikappanūpagaṃ pacchimaṃ.
pli-tv-bu-vb-np5:3.1.15: nissajjitabbaṃ saṅghassa vā gaṇassa vā puggalassa vā.
pli-tv-bu-vb-np5:3.1.18: idaṃ me bhante cīvaraṃ aññātikāya bhikkhuniyā hatthato paṭiggahitaṃ aññatra pārivaṭṭakā nissaggiyaṃ
pli-tv-bu-vb-np5:3.2.1: aññātikāya aññātikasaññī hatthato cīvaraṃ paṭiggaṇhāti aññatra pārivaṭṭakā nissaggiyaṃ pācittiyaṃ.
pli-tv-bu-vb-np5:3.2.2: aññātikāya vematiko hatthato cīvaraṃ paṭiggaṇhāti aññatra pārivaṭṭakā nissaggiyaṃ pācittiyaṃ.
pli-tv-bu-vb-np5:3.2.3: aññātikāya ñātikasaññī hatthato cīvaraṃ paṭiggaṇhāti aññatra pārivaṭṭakā nissaggiyaṃ pācittiyaṃ.
pli-tv-bu-vb-np5:3.2.4: ekatoupasampannāya hatthato cīvaraṃ paṭiggaṇhāti aññatra pārivaṭṭakā āpatti dukkaṭassa.
pli-tv-bu-vb-np5:3.3.3: pārivaṭṭakaṃ parittena vā vipulaṃ vipulena vā parittaṃ
